bundle.shortDescription: A lighting-desk command line for LivePremier switchers
bundle.longDescription: Type Recall, Store and Take instead of hunting for a button. A command line for Analog Way LivePremier (Aquilon) switchers, using the grammar rules of a lighting desk and the vocabulary of a video switcher. The desktop build talks to the switcher directly, which a browser on an https page cannot.
